```{r}
library(censobr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
# codigo ibge salvador 2927408
dados_censo <-
  censobr::read_households(year = 2010) %>%
  filter(code_muni == 2927408) %>%
  collect()
write.csv(dados_censo, 'salvador_2010.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
